query: This is our biggest account by revenue but there has been no activity or signal in months. Build the case for why we should reach out now.
expected_behavior: Applies the Why-Now test and does not manufacture a signal where none exists
Labels the account 'no current signal' and deprioritizes it rather than inventing urgency
Does not treat account size alone as a reason to act now
If it recommends contact, it proposes a genuine multi-threading or discovery step, not a fabricated trigger
